Development-only shader decompilers (never deployed to Publishing builds):

- cmd_Decompiler.exe : 3DMigoto DXBC decompiler (vendored here for SM4/SM5 DXBC shaders).
- decomp.exe         : RenoDX DXIL decompiler (place here or in Luma/Decompilers/ for SM6 DXIL shaders;
                       invoked with --flatten --do-while).
